      Problem: The `edit_claim_regex` pattern is duplicated — once hardcoded in the contradiction warning check (lines 1957-1958) and once as a variable definition (line 1976).; If a future update adds new edit verbs to the regex at line 1976 but forgets to update the hardcoded copy at line 1957-1958, contradictions containing those new verbs won't trigger the warning.       Problem: The check `[ "${change_status}" = "edited" ] || [ "${change_status}" = "not-edited" ]` uses exact string matching. If an editor adds a qualifier (e.g., "not-edited (review only)"), the sed cleanup leaves the qualifier, making the string not match either value, causing it to fall back to heuristic detection instead of using the authoritative path.; Editors that add qualifiers to the status (violating the contract) won't trigger the authoritative path and won't show the contradiction warning.
